The *Journal of Sport & Exercise Psychology* is an official publication of the North American Society for the Psychology of Sport and Physical Activity. Sam Logan, Oregon State University (Chair). Darice Brooks, Michigan State University (Student Representative). David Anderson – San Francisco State University. Janet Hauck – Michigan State University. Priya Patel, California State University Fullerton. Liam O’Neil – Utah State University (Student Representative). Then, I will discuss the research of my group and my colleagues on the ontogeny of locomotion to illustrate how the choice of a suitable context, using a mini skateboard adapted to the newborn’s morphology, has enabled us to study primitive crawling from birth, showing that newborns are able to use quadrupedal neuro circuitry to propel themselves and that this neonatal crawling is already controlled at supra spinal level by visual, olfactory and auditory stimuli. I will conclude this talk with a discussion of the importance of research addressing racial microaggressions in sports, with particular attention to developing interventions tailored for athletes, coaches, and other training staff.
